anti_goals: Do not redesign model prompting, edit formats, retry policy, or response processing.
Do not force provider-specific optional values into requests when the user did not configure them.
Do not retain credentials in unrelated domain constructor signatures merely to initialize a shared provider client.
Do not claim end-to-end provider connectivity without a request-level or integration oracle.
cases.expected_postcondition: The application boundary accepts the supported optional provider settings and initializes the shared provider client before constructing downstream components; omitted optional settings are not overwritten.
cases.oracle: Verify each supplied interface value maps to the correct client attribute before component creation and that omitted optional values are not assigned.
cases.precondition: The application accepts only key and base settings, while the domain component constructor owns provider-module initialization and forces a default base value.
